name: GLM (Z.ai)
_selectorsNote: Checked against the live page on 2026-10-22 as a guest: input, #send-message-button, the Stop button (button[aria-label=Stop], shown while a reply generates) and the .chat-assistant reply container. The reply text itself was not seen - a guest send raises an Aliyun slider CAPTCHA.

completionRules._maxWaitNote: Raised from 120s. A reasoning model on a plan- or build-sized prompt was still thinking when the old wait expired, so a partial response got extracted and then failed to parse. The wait ends as soon as the reply is complete, so a longer ceiling costs nothing on fast answers.

_controlsNote: Radix UI. Options carry data-value and data-selected. The casing of data-value is inconsistent in GLM's own markup - copy these values verbatim, do not derive them from the labels. Search / Advanced Search is not wired: its trigger was not captured.
_comingSoonReason: Gated again on 2026-10-23: the selectors match the live page (checked 2026-10-22), but a guest send raises an Aliyun slider CAPTCHA and no signed-in reply has been read yet. It stays listed, not selectable, until a signed-in smoke test passes.
_contextBudgetNote: Roughly how much conversation this provider will hold before a build should continue in a new thread, in characters. A deliberately conservative guess - nothing can read the real window, and being wrong in this direction costs one seeded prompt while being wrong the other way loses a step fifteen deep. Counted from what we send and the replies we receive, never from the page.
